messages:
Ibrahim: Quick UX thread — discovered a confusing ordering case in the Rules preview: when multiple rules have the same priority we hide the manual order, which leads to 'ghosting' in the simulation UI. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/unik/priority-ghosting
Nina: Ghosting = users think a rule disappeared, right? They expect deterministic visible order. We should show a tiny lineage marker like "order: manual" and a subtle drag hint when priorities tie.
Olga: Yes. Also propose an "order-lock" toggle per-rule so teams can pin important rules even if they share priority numbers. UI: a lock icon that becomes focusable and has tooltip: "Pin this rule's position".
Sam: Accessibility: lock button must be reachable via keyboard and announce state changes via aria-live. For drag handle we should support a keyboard reordering mode (activate with Space -> then Up/Down arrows).
Ibrahim: Validation copy around the lock state: current toast says "Order conflict". Suggest inline helper: "Conflicting priority: pin this rule to keep it above peers." Short, actionable.
Nina: Preview visuals: instead of full-row bg highlight use a 3px left stripe + micro badge that says "matched". Keeps density and reduces layout jump when previews update rapidly.
Olga: Spinner problem: when you flip sample inputs quickly the preview spinner sometimes persists. Eng hint: cancel previous XHR/fetch and set a 200ms debounce. Also provide a tiny non-blocking skeleton so users know things are updating.
Sam: A11y nit: muted timestamps and helper text fall under contrast at 12px. design-bot, can you run a quick check on the prototype? If any fail, bump to #50555A.
design-bot: Contrast scan complete: 3 tokens below AA in current frame (ids: badge-7, hint-2, ts-4). Recommend color #50555A for those tokens. Also recorded focus order snapshot.
Ibrahim: Another edge case: programmatic reorders via API don't surface in the UI until a refresh. Suggest a small toast: "Order updated remotely — view changes" with a quick highlight option.
Nina: Copy for the inline pin: title="Pinned — keeps this rule at its current index"; tooltip action: "Press Space to toggle pin".
Olga: For mobile, make the lock larger and avoid hover-only affordances. If lock visible, ensure 44px touch target.
Sam: Action items: Nina to mock lock state and pin microcopy, Olga to add preview stripe + badge, Ibrahim to spec remote-update toast, I'll follow up with aria-live and keyboard-reorder pattern. Review in 2 days. :thumbsup:
